verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say it creates system snapshots automatically on every Omarchy update, and users can make their own with `omarchy-snapshot create`. That is the product's own foundation for this story. However, the evidence never documents the actual rollback/restore step, so the core outcome of reverting a broken system is only implied. Missing for 10: documented restore/rollback procedure (e.g., a restore command or boot-time snapshot selection), details on what the snapshots cover, and independent or hands-on confirmation that rollback works after a bad update.
